goal: Build the star schema of docs/contracts/star-schema.md as a SQLMesh project over the committed S1 snapshot, with audits and the competition seed, so that the compiler (S3a) and the golden reproduction (S3b) query tables whose row count and totals provably match the publisher's.
owned_paths: docs/sources.md, to follow the reporting_uei revision of the contract only
.gitignore, to add SQLMesh cache or log paths only
out_of_scope: any change to docs/contracts/star-schema.md, data/snapshot/, docs/golden/ or the S3a catalog and compiler
dbt or any second modelling tool: if SQLMesh cannot do the job, stop and report
Parquet exports for Power BI (S3c) and the golden reproduction through the compiler (S3b)
sentinel or unknown dimension rows: no invented keys
network calls other than package installs
done_means: pyproject.toml adds sqlmesh pinned to one exact version, named in the report with its PyPI source; duckdb stays at 1.5.6 unless sqlmesh refuses it, which is then reported; uv.lock is regenerated by uv

uv run sqlmesh -p warehouse plan --auto-apply --no-prompts builds, from data/snapshot/contract_transactions.parquet into a DuckDB file under data/tmp/, exactly the tables and columns of docs/contracts/star-schema.md, fed by the source fields named in docs/sources.md

dim_date has every day of fiscal year 2025 with the contract's fiscal fields (October is fiscal month 1); the fact carries reporting_uei per transaction (the parent UEI recorded on it, else recipient_uei); dim_recipient has one row per recipient UEI and dim_reporting_recipient one row per reporting_uei, as the contract says

a seed under warehouse/seeds/ lists every extent-competed code found in the snapshot with its description and is_competed; docs/warehouse.md cites the source of that mapping; it agrees with the competed codes used by the derived golden values; a null competition_code stays null
audits: transaction_key unique and not null; every non-null foreign key of the fact exists in its dimension; the null count of each foreign key is written to the report

a pytest test builds the project into a temporary DuckDB and checks the fact's row count and obligation sum against data/snapshot/manifest.json, and three golden values on three different dimensions (one by fiscal month) and the derived recipients.top10_reporting_share against docs/golden/golden.json, to the cent
uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q && python3 scripts/commit_hygiene.py
stop_and_report_when: SQLMesh cannot build the contract tables in this session: commit what is sound, describe the blocker and propose, without making, a dbt-duckdb fallback
a contract column has no source field, or the seed's competed codes disagree with the derived golden values: report it and change neither the contract nor the golden file
a dependency beyond sqlmesh and what it pulls in seems necessary
hand_back: The branch s2-sqlmesh-models, pushed to origin and never merged, with the report committed as tasks/reports/s2-sqlmesh-models.md: outcome, the verification output, the sqlmesh version, each built table with its row count, the null count per foreign key, the three golden checks and the seed's source. The owner opens the pull request from the pushed branch.
note: Plan row S2, time-boxed to one session. Serves ADR-0001 and ADR-0002. Starts only after S1 is merged into main. Snapshot facts at 2026-11-01: 12,687 rows, 24 columns, no null foreign key except extent_competed_code (5 rows) and the place-of-performance state (10 rows); competition codes A, B, C, D, F, G; one awarding sub-agency; 13 recipients change parent during the year.
